title: Listen to Kie Senpai's new "Sunday Morning" track featuring Tibli Studios
htmlContent:
Kie Senpai shares a new "Sunday Morning" song featuring Tibli Studios. The song is a confession track that follows a man confessing his true love to a young lady and the outpour of emotions. It brings power back to a wrong time of heartache and heartbreak. He delivers an emotionally punchy version with unique lyrics and a smooth melodic run that is also catchy. Follow Kie Senpai and Tibli Studios on all social media.

Listen to Kie Senpai's new single, "Sunday Morning."
